segments.name: Material Handling
segments.description: Sells, rents and services material handling equipment and warehouse automation solutions, with parts and maintenance, for industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Additionally, we provide design and build services related to automated equipment installation and warehouse management system integration solutions within our Material Handling segment.

segments.name: Construction Equipment
segments.description: Sells, rents and services heavy and compact construction equipment, crushing, screening and paving equipment, with parts, for contractors.
segments.evidence: In our Material Handling segment, our rental equipment sales are primarily of rent-to-rent equipment and in our Construction Equipment segment, our rental equipment sales are primarily of rent-to-sell equipment.

segments.name: Master Distribution
segments.description: Distributes equipment and parts to sub-dealers, mainly for European OEMs exposed to tariffs on imported goods.
segments.evidence: Master Distribution segment revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 were $67.3 million, an increase of $8.1 million from the prior year same period.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for new and used equipment, parts, repair and maintenance services, equipment rentals and rental equipment sales.
revenueModel.evidence: We engage in five principal business activities in these equipment categories: (i) new and used equipment sales; (ii) parts sales; (iii) repair and maintenance services; (iv) equipment rentals and (v) rental equipment sales.

changes.text: In 2025 the company completed two divestitures, removing the disposed businesses from its segments.
changes.evidence: and other investing activities partially offset by $20.9 million proceeds from the two divestitures discussed in Note 15, and $11.4 million proceeds from the sale of rent-to-rent equipment and non-rental property and equipment.
